evidence: Changes Guix build manifests and depends to build Linux release binaries as static position-independent executables (`-static-pie`).
rationale: Compiling Linux release binaries with `-static-pie` provides broad platform portability, enabling executables to run across non-glibc distros like Alpine Linux and older distributions without shared library mismatch issues. Reviewers across Alpine, NixOS, and older Linux environments confirm it eliminates the need for dynamic linker shims and resolves issue #19075.
